en.hubeali:
Ali Bin Ibrahim, from his father, from Ibn Abu Umeyr, from Hammad Bin Usman, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> having said:
‘When the man reaches fifty years, so he should not go to sleep and inside him is something from the margarine’.
en.sarwar: 4. Ali ibn Ibrahim has narrated from his father from ibn abu ‘Umayr from Hammad ibn ‘Uthaman who has said the following: “Abu ‘Abd Allah, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, has said, ‘
When a man becomes fifty years old he must not go to sleep with an amount of ghee in his stomach.’”
